description: Know which talk you're giving — the pitch (drive one decision) vs. the teach (build understanding) — because mixing their structures fails both, and most bad presentations are one wearing the other's clothes. Use when asked is this a pitch or a training, my informative deck didn't land the ask, my pitch felt like a lecture, or structure this talk for the right job.
